name: Kaiserlift Kufstein Naturerlebnis Brentenjoch
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Kaiserlift in Kufstein: nostalgic 1-seater chairlift into the Kaisergebirge nature reserve at 1,256 m with panoramic views and hiking trails.
beschreibung:
Overview

The time-honoured Kaiserlift Kufstein departs from the Kufstein district of Obere Sparchen at the foot of the mighty Kaisergebirge mountains at an elevation of around 500 metres. Following comprehensive revitalisation and reopening in 2015, this heritage-protected, nostalgic single-seater chairlift transports nature enthusiasts and hikers across two tranquil sections up to the Brentenjoch at 1,256 metres above sea level. Operating as a unique railway of deceleration, the Kaiserlift opens the gateway to the strictly protected Naturschutzgebiet Kaisergebirge (Kaisergebirge Nature Reserve), captivating visitors with pristine alpine landscapes, heavenly silence, and a magnificent panorama of the rugged limestone ramparts of the Zahmer Kaiser and Wilder Kaiser.

Nostalgic Chairlift & Kaisergebirge Nature Reserve

The original chairlift was constructed back in the 1970s; today, guests glide almost silently in open individual chairs above blossoming alpine meadows, dense mixed forests, and prominent rock crags. The approximately 20-minute ascent is considered the quintessential alpine slow-travel experience: floating gently toward the sky away from all hustle and bustle, while taking in an ever-widening panorama over the Kufstein basin, the Inn Valley, and the Bavarian Prealps. At the Brentenjoch mountain station, an extensive network of first-rate hiking trails and themed paths begins: exceptionally popular is the relaxed pasture walk via the Duxeralm, the Kaindlhütte (1,293 m), or the summit of the Gamskogel (1,449 m). Along the Naturerlebnisweg Kaisergebirge, interactive learning stations and ancient stone spiral labyrinths explain alpine geology, rare flora such as gentian and arnica, and the alpine farming heritage of Kufstein. For experienced mountaineers, the Brentenjoch serves as an ideal launching pad for demanding rock climbs and via ferrata routes in the Wilder Kaiser.

Visit & Getting There

The Kaiserlift Kufstein operates during the summer season from early May to late October daily from 08:30 to 16:30 (on weekends in July and August until 17:00; weather-related safety pauses may occur during storms or torrential rain). Summer 2025/2026 fares (ascent and descent across both sections): adults approx. €24.00, seniors approx. €21.50, children and youths (born 2007–2018) approx. €14.00, children under 6 ride free. Holders of the regional KufsteinerlandCard benefit from discounted fares. Getting there by car: via the Inntalautobahn A12 (exit Kufstein Nord), follow signs toward Sparchen or Kaiserlift; paid parking spaces are available right at the valley station (Kienbergstraße 40). By public transport: ÖBB/S-Bahn train to Kufstein railway station, from where Kufstein city bus line 1 or 2 runs every 20 minutes directly to the Kufstein Kaiserlift stop.

Tips

Because this is an open single-seater chairlift, wheelchairs and prams cannot be transported (children must measure at least 1.10 m in height to ride safely). Sturdy hiking shoes and windproof clothing are strongly recommended, as the ride glides high above the ground. Stop by the traditional Alpengasthof Brentenjoch right at the mountain station and savour freshly prepared Tyrolean Kasspatzln while taking in views of the Zahmer Kaiser.
oeffnungszeiten: Mai bis Okt täglich 08:30–16:30 Uhr (Hochsommer bis 17:00 Uhr)
